title: RyxoNET
body:
**Protect your backend servers smarter, cleaner and more flexibly.**

RyxoNET is a modern, lightweight and highly configurable security plugin designed for Paper, Purpur, Spigot servers — especially those running behind a proxy (Velocity, Waterfall, BungeeCord) or even standalone setups.

It gives you powerful tools to prevent direct IP connections, IP spoofing, proxy bypass attempts and unwanted hostname usage all in one clean package.

### Key Features
- 4 Security Modes: choose exactly what you need • WHITELIST_ONLY – classic IP whitelist • PROXY_PROTECTED – strong passphrase + session validation • HYBRID – combine whitelist + proxy protection • HOSTNAME_ONLY – force players to connect via your domain only (with reverse DNS support)

- Smart Hostname Enforcement: Encourage / force players to use your official domain (e.g. play.yourserver.net) instead of raw IP Custom kick messages (multi-line, color supported)

- Server IP Binding Check: Optionally verify that incoming connections match your known public server IP

- Modern & Clean Codebase: Fully modular structure • Proper caching & validation • Detailed configurable logging • Tab-completion & rich admin commands

**Powerful Admin Commands:**
/ryxonet reload
/ryxonet status
/ryxonet addhost <domain>
/ryxonet removehost <domain>
/ryxonet listhosts

**Lightweight & Up-to-date** Built for 1.19–1.21+ (Paper/Purpur API) Maven project, Java 17, clean dependencies

### Why choose RyxoNET over older / more limited protection plugins?
- More security modes — not just proxy protection
- Better admin experience (in-game host management, detailed status)
- Cleaner, more maintainable code (no spaghetti, proper packages & utilities)
- Actively designed for 2025–2026 servers (modern API, better logging, flexibility)
- Clearer kick messages and more player-friendly enforcement
- Easier to extend and customize for your network

### Who is it for?
- Server owners who want more control than basic proxy authentication
- Networks that care about clean branding (domain-only connections)
- Admins tired of outdated, hard-to-configure protection plugins
- Anyone who wants a modern alternative with better features and support

### Installation
1. Drop RyxoNET.jar into your plugins folder
2. Start / restart server
3. Edit plugins/RyxoNET/config.yml to your needs
4. Use /ryxonet reload or restart

### Permissions
- ryxonet.admin – access to all management commands (default: op)
